paper_title: Incorporating Domain Knowledge into Materials Tokenization
caption: Comparison of Macro-F1 scores for ChemDataExtractor and MatDetector across values.
model_annotation: This line plot compares the Macro-F1 scores (%) for two methods, MatDetector (ours) and ChemDataExtractor, as a function of the λ value. The x-axis, labeled "λ value", uses a linear scale ranging from "w/o" (indicating no λ value applied) to 3, with tick labels at regular intervals of 0.1 from 0.1 to 0.9, and then at integer values 1, 2, and 3. The y-axis, labeled "Macro-F1 Score (%)", uses a linear scale ranging from 72.0 to 75.5. The "MatDetector (ours)" line is represented by a magenta line with circular markers and a solid line style; it starts at approximately 72.5% at "w/o", rises to a peak of 75.5% at λ=1, then declines to approximately 72.5% at λ=3. The "ChemDataExtractor" line is represented by a dark blue line with square markers and a dashed line style; it begins at approximately 72.5% at "w/o", generally follows a trend slightly below MatDetector, reaches a peak of approximately 73.5% at λ=0.5, and then declines to approximately 72.0% at λ=3.
